meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex 安装，与最新官方源码对比，输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，并只给出修复建议，不主动修改任何配置。
howto.when: 当用户要求健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等关键词、或怀疑安装过时/损坏/行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我做个 LazyCodex 健康检查。
say.note: Claude 将同步最新源码并检查本地安装。

say.text: 我的 Codex 刚刚更新后出问题了，查一下。
say.note: Claude 会运行诊断并标记异常。

say.text: 对比我本地的 Codex 和最新版，看有没有漂移。
say.note: 它会检查配置和插件，输出差异。

howto.what_en: Claude audits the local LazyCodex and Codex installation against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence. Read-only: suggests fixes, never modifies config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a health check, mentions LazyCodex or similar, or suspects a stale, broken, or oddly behaving install.

say_en.note: Claude syncs sources and inspects the install.

say_en.text: My Codex acts up after the update; diagnose.
Compare my local Codex against the latest.
say_en.note: It checks config and plugins for drift.
